name: JanusGraph Open-Source Distributed Graph Database
free_limit: Apache-2.0 licensed self-managed transactional graph database with Apache TinkerPop/Gremlin support; no vendor license fee or software usage quota.
watch_out: Requires user-operated compute, graph storage backend (for example Cassandra/HBase/Bigtable), optional search indexing (Elasticsearch/Solr/Lucene), security, backup and maintenance. Cloud backends and managed hosting can charge separately.
